title: A high throughput DNA extraction method from chemotypically heterogeneous plant species
protocol: Turn on a water bath and set temperature at 65°C.
Grind plant material with mortar and pestle in the presence of extraction buffer \[200 mM Tris-HCL \(pH 8.0), 75 mM NaCl, 12.5 mM EDTA, and 0.5% PVP].
Transfer the homogenate to a 1.5 ml micro-centrifuge tube.
Vortex the tube for 30 seconds after adding 10% SDS solution.
Incubate the tube in a water bath at 65°C for 20-40 minutes and mix the contents 2-3 times by inverting the tubes.
Centrifuge the tube at 17,000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Take the upper aqueous phase into a new tube.
Mix with an equal volume of phenol: chloroform: isoamyl alcohol \(25:24:1, v/v/v).
Shake the tube well for 5 minutes and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Collect the supernatant into a fresh tube.
Add 1/5th volume of 2 M NaCl and 2 volumes of pre-chilled ethanol.
Keep the tube at -20°C for 10 minutes to precipitate DNA.
Spool the DNA and transfer to another tube.
Wash the spooled DNA with 70% ethanol \(2-3 times).
Air dry under laminar flow chamber for 10-15 minutes.
Dissolve the dry pellet in nuclease-free water or TE buffer \(pH 8.0).
